correctness.rationale: On Hermitian 3-by-3 matrices, averaging over four even sign changes splits the orbit projector frame into one 3-by-3 diagonal sector and three 2-by-2 character sectors. Three-cycle averaging yields the exact levels 4, 6D−2 (twice), 2(1−D)±4|C_v| (three each). The trace fixes the maximal smallest eigenvalue at 1, and equality forces D=1/2 and C_v=0. For the exhibited normalized vector exact sympy matrix-unit computations give T(E_ij)=E_ij+delta_ij I, and randomized spectrum tests corroborate (not prove) the general formula. All assumptions and exact finite dimension are explicit.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact tomography spectrum and sharp stability design within the natural 12-rotation tetrahedral measurement architecture in complex dimension three. The equality locus is a concrete nontrivial quadratic condition on arbitrary complex fiducials, with a radical-valued fiducial exhibiting exact condition number two on Hermitian matrices. It provides deterministic robust qutrit matrix reconstruction from a group orbit and distinguishes full linear matrix recovery from weaker pure-state recovery. The result is not merely the standard abstract projective-design identity.
